opticalProfiles.distance_tolerance_note: Fixed mirror-type lens: the maker table ratio drifts from 0.344 at 120 inches to 0.358 at 600 inches because of the fixed offset; plan with the tolerance margin and confirm on site.
opticalProfiles.notes_for_throwline: Ultra short throw mirror lens: no back-of-projector mark; use the maker drawing for body position.

lens_shift_combined_rule.note: EB-L30000U specification: when the horizontal direction is at its maximum the image cannot be moved upward. The horizontal maximum for ELPLX03 is not stated in readable maker text, so the combined check cannot run until it is.

researchExceptions.description: Per-lens mechanical shift % for ET-D3QW200 and ET-D3QS400 is not clearly isolated from projector-level max shift figures across the catalog and manual; degree values found appear to represent keystone correction angle, not shift percent
researchExceptions.recommendation: Retrieve dedicated single-lens datasheet PDFs (e.g. ET-D3QW200 lens spec sheet) analogous to ET-D3QT500's if available, to isolate shift % per lens
researchExceptions.resolution: ET-D3QS400 shift is +/-0.16 H, +/-0.45 V per the PT-RQ50K manual lens shift range (p.76). ET-D3QW200 remains unresolved: it is absent from the 2019 manual and the Optional Lens Guide gives no width basis.

researchExceptions.description: Sony VPL-GTZ380 lens throw ratios differ between the primary datasheet's main table (0.80-1.02:1 / 1.40-2.73:1, basis unstated) and a secondary table on the same PDF plus Sony Canada/Value Electronics reprints (0.85-1.09:1 / 1.49-2.91:1, explicitly for 16:9 display size)
researchExceptions.recommendation: Confirm with Sony professional support whether the differing values represent different aspect-ratio/display-size bases (16:9 vs. panel-native) rather than a genuine discrepancy; do not average or pick arbitrarily
researchExceptions.resolution: The Sony help guide projection tables show 0.80-1.02:1 / 1.40-2.73:1 are distance over image width for the native 17:9 picture and 0.85-1.09:1 / 1.49-2.91:1 the same for a 16:9 picture. Both are recorded as aspect variants; no conflict remains.

researchExceptions.description: Barco UDX-4K32 spec sheet gives only a projector-level combined lens-shift range (-100% to +130% V, up to +/-40% H) 'depending on lens' rather than per-TLD+-lens shift figures In the 2026-09-04 pass Barco’s per-lens pages could not be read (HTTP 403 for automated access), so per-lens shift and the width basis of the TLD+ ratios remain unconfirmed.
researchExceptions.recommendation: Locate individual TLD+ lens datasheets (e.g. TLD+ 0.37, TLD+ 1.25-1.6) on barco.com resource/downloads pages for lens-specific shift, F-number, and throw-basis data

researchExceptions.description: VPL-GTZ380 is a home-cinema/high-end consumer product rather than professional installation/rental gear; included per user instruction but market segment must remain clearly flagged as home_theater_high_end and not merged with professional large-venue categories
researchExceptions.recommendation: Keep segregated in any filtered views of the database that target professional AV/rental use cases

researchExceptions.description: Panasonic manual throw-ratio tables for ET-D3QT600/ET-D3QT700 show an apparent value overlap between the 16:9 column of one lens and the 4:3 column description text extracted from the search snippet; this may be a search-tool extraction artifact rather than a true source conflict
researchExceptions.recommendation: Re-verify exact per-aspect-ratio throw ratio table directly from the official manual PDF pages (not just search snippet) before using QT600/QT700 16:9 and 4:3 values in production calculations
researchExceptions.resolution: Reading the manual directly shows distinct columns: ET-D3QT600 16:9 2.87-4.13:1 and 4:3 3.84-5.53:1; ET-D3QT700 16:9 4.14-5.83:1 and 4:3 5.54-7.80:1. The overlap was a search-snippet artifact.

researchExceptions.description: Full TLD+ lens family (0.65-0.85, 0.8-1.16:1, 1.5-2.0:1, 2.0-2.8:1, 2.8-4.5:1, 4.5-7.5:1, 7.5-11.5:1) referenced in UDX-4K32 spec sheet was not individually profiled in this pilot pass; only 0.37 and 1.25-1.6 lenses were built out as optical_profiles records
researchExceptions.recommendation: Expand Barco lens coverage in next research phase by pulling each TLD+ lens's individual datasheet

researchExceptions.description: The UDX-4K32 spec sheet names the lens "TLD+ 0.37" while Barco’s lens listing (search-indexed title of the R9801661 page) gives 0.39:1 for WUXGA 0.96-inch, 0.42:1 for WQXGA 0.90-inch, and 0.36:1 for 0.98-inch 4K chips. The UDX-4K32 uses the 0.90-inch WQXGA chip, so its ratio is most likely 0.42:1, not 0.37.
researchExceptions.recommendation: Read the Barco lens page or datasheet from a normal network and record the WQXGA value with its width basis before enabling calculation.

researchExceptions.description: ET-D3QW200 is listed in the Panasonic Optional Lens Guide at 0.548-0.650:1 (Native 4K) but the 2019 PT-RQ50K Operating Instructions predate the lens and the guide does not state an image-width basis, so no optical profile was created.
researchExceptions.recommendation: Obtain the ET-D3QW200 datasheet or a later manual revision with a projection distance table listing image width.

researchExceptions.description: The PT-RQ50K operating instructions show the combined lens shift range only as an illustration (pages 75-76); the text gives the vertical and horizontal maximums but not the shape of the combined range. Throwline models it as an oval inside the maximums (lens_shift_combined_rule basis: assumed).
researchExceptions.recommendation: Transcribe the maker figure (corner cut-offs or curve) into a stated rule, or obtain a Panasonic document that gives the combined range as a formula.
